paths.name: elastic_uniaxial

provenance.temperature: no temperature stated; TEMP=0 and DTEMP=0 (isothermal). A routine that reads TEMP as a field (e.g. non-local damage) sees zero
provenance.elastic: one decade below the registry activation_amplitude 0.01 (Abaqus amplitude search on the original)
provenance.inelastic: 2 x registry activation_amplitude 0.01; note the registry value is the amplitude the search settled on, which for a model that never activates is its probe amplitude, not a transition
provenance.finite: 0.2: kinematic requirement (>= 2% per experiment.MEANINGFUL_ACTIVATION['finite strain'], x10 so geometric terms exceed check tolerances)
provenance.model_domain: total time <= 13 (author's deck: step periods 1, 1, 1, 10 (total 13)); this path ends at 13
